text:
alex: Heads-up: planning infra apply during tonight's release window (UTC 02:00). Affects modules: networking/vpc, iam/service-accounts, kms/keys. Will run staggered across regions.

alex: high-level plan:
- canary apply in eu-west-1 (small subset of subnets)
- wait 10m smoke + metrics check
- stagger us-east-1 and ap-southeast-1 if healthy
- pinned provider/module versions to avoid drift

alex: pinned versions used:
```
provider "aws" { version = "~> 4.60.0" }
module "vpc" { source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/vpc.git?ref=v1.4.2" }
```

deploybot: preflight checks passed: plan succeeded, no unexpected deletions in iam, state lock available. CI tags: release/2026-03-21.

maria: quick Q — kms key rotation in this change? I think we only attach a new key policy and add the kms:Encrypt permission to sa-redwood.

cheng: correct, no rotation. Just policy update and a new role mapping. Safe for canary.

sam: I'll watch CloudWatch + request latency for 30m after each region. Will earmark dashboards and set a temporary alarm at 4x baseline.

irene: approval: +1 from security for policy diff. Leaving final GO to infra oncall.

alex: rollback plan: revert to prior module tag v1.4.1 and reapply if we see elevated 5xx or IAM denies. Manual rollback steps in playbook:
```
# rollback quick commands
git checkout refs/tags/v1.4.1 -- modules/vpc
terraform apply -var-file=release-20260321.tfvars -target=module.vpc -auto-approve
```

alex: also keep deploybot circuit-breaker on: if deploybot sees >10% plan Drifts or >3 provider errors it will abort.

deploybot: executing canary in 10m. Command used: `deploybot run --workspace infra-prod --workspace-override region=eu-west-1 --staged 30`

opsbot: change window reminder pinned to #eng-infra. Quiet window enforced from 01:30–03:30 UTC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

cheng: small note — we'll use a serial apply for the iam changes to avoid transient races: apply iam module first, then vpc. Script in repo ensures sequencing.

maria: confirm service-account creds rotation is off during apply? we don't want to rotate keys mid-apply.

alex: correct — creds rotation paused for 60m starting at 01:45 UTC. I've added a keepalive TTL to the SA.

sam: if anything looks off I'll trigger the rollback playbook and ping #oncall-sre.

irene: tagging release notes: add entry under "infra" -> "Updated IAM policy for kms:Encrypt on sa-redwood, VPC route table cleanup".

deploybot: canary complete: plan -> apply started. No errors so far. Applied 7 resources in eu-west-1.

alex: waiting 12m for smoke. Sam monitoring.

srebot: alert check: 0.9% increase in 5xx across canary endpoints — within threshold. No action.

sam: smoke looks clean. CPU and p95 latency within normal. Green to proceed to us-east-1.

deploybot: us-east-1 apply kicking off now, staged across 3 AZs with 90s waits.

alex: final notes: keep provider versions pinned in module refs for next 2 releases. We'll schedule a dedicated provider bump test next sprint.

opsbot: change window end will auto-lift at 03:30 UTC, but we'll keep monitoring for 2 hours after. :eyes:

cheng: all done — no rollbacks required. Closing thread after postmortem if anything pops. Thanks team. :tada:
